author: Animalogic
description:
n the year 2001, all living Iberian lynxes could fit in a school bus. Today their numbers have recovered to over 2,000 and a big part of that is lynx school. Lynxes were bred in captivity and taught to be wild. This is the story of the greatest recovery in cat history. 

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
